summary: I mean look at panel @aei put together on "future of #Higher Ed" full of white folk from private institutions. Not one speaker of color, not one person from public education, not one speaker from a community college. It is a panel on the past not future
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I mean look at panel @aei put together on "future of #Higher Ed" full of white folk from private institutions. Not one speaker of color, not one person from public education, not one speaker from a community college. It is a panel on the past not future
